method: Generated via scripts/optimize_sentiment_keywords.py (trading_relevance scoring with base + crypto slang lexicon) + cumulative manual review of samples across multiple runs. Prioritizes organic token price/action discussion over company news or listing hype spam.
notes: X (primary) prefers clean or $ticker for trading signals. Reddit uses lists (first is primary). 'ripple' consistently underperforms for XRP token trading talk vs 'XRP'. BTC benefits from both 'BTC' and 'bitcoin'. Re-run optimizer on new pairs or monthly.

BTC-USD.notes: Both terms used by traders; 'bitcoin' often surfaces more conviction/whale discussion in tests.

SOL-USD.notes: $SOL performed strongly in some optimizer runs for trading hype signals.

XRP-USD.notes: Strong cumulative evidence: 'XRP' / '$XRP' produces better trading-relevant token signals than 'ripple' (which pulls more company/news). Do not use 'ripple' as primary.

ARB-USD.notes: Ticker preferred for low-volume pairs in relevance tests.
